reviews.text: Ce nettoyant avait tout pour plaire : texture agréable, mousse douce qui se rince très bien. Malheureusement, il m'a provoqué une réaction inflammatoire sur tout le visage et le cou, démangeaisons horribles, boursoufflures, peau rugueuse . . . Depuis 2 jours ma peau est dans cet état après l'avoir utilisé seulement pendant ... 2 jours ! Je vais mettre du temps à ce que ma barrière cutanée soit bien restaurée...
reviews.zh: 呢款潔面產品本來條件都幾好：質地舒服，泡沫温和，沖洗得好乾淨。可惜，佢令我全面同頸都出現發炎反應，痕癢得好厲害，起咗小疙瘩，皮膚變得粗糙。我只係用咗……兩日，而家我嘅皮膚就係呢個狀態，我要花好長時間先可以修復皮膚屏障……

reviews.text: My skin is not delicate, I have been using retinol for a long time, I know how and what to combine, but in the morning I was just learning and felt that after a regular serum my skin was already sore, red, I didn't understand what it was, and in the evening I tried again... and now I have been restoring the skin barrier for 3 days now. Maybe it suits someone, but I've used several products from this company and they're not very good, so even though I love Korean cosmetics, I won't buy anything from this brand again.
reviews.zh: 我嘅皮膚唔係好嬌弱，我用視黃醇已經好耐，我知道點樣同咩配搭。但係今朝我啱啱學緊，感覺用咗普通精華之後皮膚已經痛、紅，我唔明白係咩事，夜晚我又試咗一次……而家我已經用咗三日修復皮膚屏障。可能啱某啲人，但係我用過呢間公司嘅幾款產品，都唔係好好，所以雖然我好鍾意韓國化妝品，我都唔會再買呢個品牌嘅任何嘢。

reviews.text: Does not strip my skin, my skin feels moisturize, if you have sensitive skin do not buy manyo cleansing foam, get this instead
reviews.zh: 唔會剝奪皮膚，我嘅皮膚摸落滋潤。如果你皮膚敏感，唔好買 manyo 嘅潔面泡沫，要買呢款。

reviews.text: i think it’s the first time that I have seem this texture for the face wash, it’s in between a gel and like aloe Vera for me. really soft and doesn’t strip my skin. nice for sensitive skin !
reviews.zh: 我諗呢係我第一次見到咁樣質地嘅潔面產品，喺凝膠同蘆薈膠之間。好軟，唔會剝奪皮膚。皮膚敏感嘅人好啱！

reviews.text: Cumple todo que permite. Aumenta las defensas de la piel. muy agradable a la hora de utilizar. Super económico - me duro más de 6 meses utilizando 2 veces al día. Recomiendo el 100%
reviews.zh: 符合佢所承諾嘅一切。增強皮膚防禦力。用起嚟好舒服。超抵——我用咗超過六個月，每日用兩次。100% 推薦。

reviews.text: This is a nice pro-biotic second or morning cleanser. A bit on the strong site, however it really cleans the skin. I use it even without an oil step if I have not much make up on. I like to use it also for the entire body. It contains a lot of planet extracts, thus you need to make sure that you have no sensitivities towards one of those!
reviews.zh: 呢款係一款好好嘅益生菌早上或者第二次潔面產品。有啲偏強，不過真係好清潔。如果我化妝唔多，我會唔使先用油性潔面，直接用。我仲鍾意全身都用佢。佢含有好多植物萃取，所以你要確保冇對其中任何一種敏感！

reviews.text: it has irritated my skin. my skin was really rough to the touch and veeeeeery dry. I stopped my whole skincare routine to get my normal skin. It took time and now I am using this cleanser to wash the beauty blender and brushes
reviews.zh: 佢令我皮膚不適。我嘅皮膚摸起嚟好粗糙，而且乾到好乾。我停咗成個護膚步驟，等返個皮膚正常。花咗啲時間，而家我用緊呢款潔面產品嚟洗 beauty blender 同刷子。

reviews.text: Bon nettoyant visage, qui assèche pas la peau. La contenance est énorme donc bon rapport qualité prix. Va me durer longtemps.
reviews.zh: 好嘅潔面產品，唔會令皮膚乾燥。容量好大，所以性價比好好。可以用好耐。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
